ex.en: I'm taking Spanish this semester.
ex.zh: 我這學期修西班牙文。

ex.en: The new school semester has started.
ex.zh: 新學期開始了。

ex.en: I haven't studied physics much all semester.
ex.zh: 我這學期幾乎沒念物理。

semester.en: one of the two main parts of a school year

ex.en: More than 90 percent of visits to a web page are from search engines.
ex.zh: 網頁超過九成的造訪量來自搜尋引擎。

ex.en: One of the major Internet search engines states that ‘Fast is better than slow’.
ex.zh: 某個主要的網路搜尋引擎說：「快比慢好。」

search engine.en: a website or program that helps you find information on the internet

ex.en: Heads up! The server will shut down at midnight.
ex.zh: 注意！伺服器半夜會關機。

ex.en: This process must be stopped immediately, otherwise the server will break down.
ex.zh: 必須立刻停止這個程序，否則伺服器會當機。

ex.en: The server is a bit slow.
ex.zh: 伺服器有點慢。

server.en: a computer that stores information and sends it to other computers

ex.en: Our server was very friendly.
ex.zh: 我們的服務生很親切。

ex.en: Ask the server for the bill.
ex.zh: 跟服務生要帳單。

server.en: a person who brings food and drink to customers in a restaurant

ex.en: Although her house is nearby, I seldom see her.
ex.zh: 雖然她家就在附近，我卻很少見到她。

ex.en: She seldom goes to that sort of place.
ex.zh: 她很少去像那樣的地方。

ex.en: I can seldom find time for reading.
ex.zh: 我很少有時間看書。

ex.en: The seller agreed to lower the price.
ex.zh: 賣家同意降價。

ex.en: Contact the seller if the item arrives damaged.
ex.zh: 如果商品到貨時有損壞，請聯絡賣家。

seller.en: a person or company that gives goods to others for money

ex.en: This model is our best seller.
ex.zh: 這款是我們最暢銷的商品。

ex.en: Her new novel became a best seller.
ex.zh: 她的新小說成了暢銷書。

seller.en: a product that is bought by many people

ex.en: Don't flip-flop the addresses of the sender and recipient!
ex.zh: 不要把寄件人和收件人的地址填反了！

ex.en: The email was returned to the sender.
ex.zh: 這封電子郵件被退回給寄件人。

sender.en: the person or company a letter or message comes from

seeker.zh: 尋求者（如 job seeker 求職者）

ex.en: Job seekers can find help at the career center.
ex.zh: 求職者可以到就業中心尋求協助。

ex.en: This place is popular with thrill seekers.
ex.zh: 這個地方很受喜歡刺激的人歡迎。

seeker.en: a person who is trying to find or get something

ex.en: We hire seasonal workers every summer.
ex.zh: 我們每年夏天都會雇用季節性員工。

ex.en: The menu changes with seasonal ingredients.
ex.zh: 菜單會隨當季食材更換。

ex.en: Sales of ice cream are highly seasonal.
ex.zh: 冰淇淋的銷售季節性很強。

seasonal.en: related to or happening in one time of the year

ex.en: Could you wrap this separately, please?
ex.zh: 可以請你分開包裝嗎？

ex.en: Please bill us separately.
ex.zh: 請幫我們分開結帳。

ex.en: Let's pay separately today.
ex.zh: 今天我們各付各的吧。

separately.en: apart from each other, not together

ex.en: I'd like to go to the seaside with you.
ex.zh: 我想和你一起去海邊。

ex.en: I picked up a pretty shell at the seaside.
ex.zh: 我在海邊撿到一個漂亮的貝殼。

ex.en: If the weather's nice, I'll go to the seaside tomorrow.
ex.zh: 如果天氣好的話，我明天就去海邊。

seaside.en: the land next to the sea, especially where people go on holiday

ex.en: He is a waiter in a seaside restaurant.
ex.zh: 他在一家海邊餐廳當服務生。

ex.en: We stayed in a small seaside town.
ex.zh: 我們住在一個海邊小鎮。

ex.en: The sewer ran under the road.
ex.zh: 下水道位在馬路底下。

ex.en: The city is repairing the old sewer system.
ex.zh: 市政府正在修理老舊的下水道系統。

ex.en: Don't pour oil down the drain into the sewer.
ex.zh: 不要把油倒進排水孔流進下水道。

sewer.en: an underground pipe that carries away dirty water and waste

ex.en: The seafood restaurants in Keelung are very famous.
ex.zh: 基隆的海鮮餐廳很有名。

ex.en: If you like seafood, you've come to the right place!
ex.zh: 如果你喜歡海鮮，那你就來對地方了！

ex.en: I really like seafood.
ex.zh: 我很喜歡海鮮。

seafood.en: fish and other animals from the ocean that people eat

serial.zh: 連續的、序列的（serial number 序號）

ex.en: Please write down the serial number on the back of the device.
ex.zh: 請記下裝置背面的序號。

ex.en: Each product has a unique serial number.
ex.zh: 每個產品都有唯一的序號。

serial.en: forming a series, one after another in order

ex.en: They have watched TV serials this evening.
ex.zh: 他們今晚看了電視連續劇。

ex.en: The novel was first published as a serial in a magazine.
ex.zh: 這部小說最初是在雜誌上連載的。

serial.en: a story shown or printed in parts over time

ex.en: I sewed the dress with silk thread.
ex.zh: 我用絲線縫了這件洋裝。

ex.en: Did you sew this by hand?
ex.zh: 這是你手縫的嗎？

ex.en: My mother gave me her sewing machine.
ex.zh: 媽媽把她的縫紉機送給我了。

sew.en: to join cloth together using a needle and thread

ex.en: She drives a white four-door sedan.
ex.zh: 她開一輛白色四門轎車。

ex.en: The rental company offered us a compact sedan.
ex.zh: 租車公司提供我們一輛小型轎車。

sedan.en: a car with four doors and a closed space for passengers and bags

ex.en: This issue must be handled with sensitivity.
ex.zh: 這個問題必須小心處理。

ex.en: I have a sensitivity to bright light.
ex.zh: 我對強光很敏感。

sensitivity.en: care and understanding about other people's feelings

ex.en: You can adjust the sensitivity of the mouse.
ex.zh: 你可以調整滑鼠的靈敏度。

ex.en: The camera has high sensitivity in low light.
ex.zh: 這台相機在低光源下靈敏度很高。

sensitivity.en: how easily a device reacts to small changes

ex.en: The policeman seized the boy by the arm.
ex.zh: 警察抓住了那個男孩的手臂。

ex.en: The boy seized the ladder, and began to climb.
ex.zh: 男孩抓住梯子，開始往上爬。

ex.en: You should seize this opportunity.
ex.zh: 你應該把握這個機會。

seize.en: to take hold of something suddenly and firmly

ex.en: The package was seized by customs.
ex.zh: 包裹被海關扣押了。

ex.en: Sami's bag was seized by police.
ex.zh: 薩米的包包被警方扣押了。

seize.en: to take something away by official power

ex.en: The senator was censured by the congressional ethics committee.
ex.zh: 那位參議員受到國會倫理委員會的譴責。

ex.en: The senator visited the factory last week.
ex.zh: 那位參議員上週參訪了工廠。

senator.en: a member of a high-level law-making group in some countries

ex.en: It was sensible of you to follow her advice.
ex.zh: 你聽從她的建議是明智的。

ex.en: His advice is always very sensible.
ex.zh: 他的建議總是很中肯。

ex.en: A sensible man wouldn't say such a thing in public.
ex.zh: 明理的人不會在公開場合說這種話。

sensible.en: showing good judgment and practical thinking

ex.en: Wear sensible shoes for the hike.
ex.zh: 去健行要穿好走的鞋。

ex.en: She always wears sensible clothes to work.
ex.zh: 她上班總是穿得簡單實用。

sensible.en: practical and comfortable rather than fashionable

ex.en: She went to a secular school.
ex.zh: 她讀的是非宗教學校。

ex.en: Christmas has become a secular holiday for many people.
ex.zh: 對很多人來說，聖誕節已經成了非宗教性的節日。

ex.en: Analysts see a secular decline in print advertising.
ex.zh: 分析師認為平面廣告呈長期衰退。

ex.en: This is a secular trend, not a short-term change.
ex.zh: 這是長期趨勢，不是短期變化。

secular.en: lasting for a very long time

semi.zh: 聯結車、半拖車（美式口語）

ex.en: A semi was blocking two lanes of the highway.
ex.zh: 一輛聯結車擋住了高速公路的兩個車道。

ex.en: My uncle drives a semi for a living.
ex.zh: 我叔叔以開聯結車為業。

semi.en: a very large truck made of a cab and a long trailer

ex.en: Our team made it to the semis.
ex.zh: 我們隊打進了準決賽。

ex.en: We lost in the semi last year.
ex.zh: 我們去年在準決賽落敗。

semi.en: one of the two games played before the final

ex.en: Consumer sentiment improved this month.
ex.zh: 這個月消費者信心有所改善。

ex.en: Investor sentiment remains weak.
ex.zh: 投資人情緒依然疲弱。

ex.en: Public sentiment is turning against the plan.
ex.zh: 輿論開始轉向反對這項計畫。

sentiment.en: the opinion or general feeling of a group of people

ex.en: There's no room for sentiment in business.
ex.zh: 做生意不能感情用事。

ex.en: Thank you for the kind sentiment in your card.
ex.zh: 謝謝你在卡片裡的暖心話語。

sentiment.en: a feeling such as love or sadness

ex.en: One day apart seems like a separation of three years.
ex.zh: 一日不見，如隔三秋。

ex.en: The separation of work and home life is important.
ex.zh: 把工作和家庭生活分開很重要。

separation.en: the state of being apart from someone or something

ex.en: After the separation, the children lived with their mother.
ex.zh: 分居之後，孩子們跟著母親住。

ex.en: They agreed on a trial separation.
ex.zh: 他們同意先試著分居一段時間。

separation.en: the state of a married couple living apart

ex.en: The setup of the new printer took only ten minutes.
ex.zh: 新印表機的安裝只花了十分鐘。

ex.en: Please follow the setup instructions carefully.
ex.zh: 請仔細依照設定說明操作。

setup.en: the act of getting a machine or program ready to use

ex.en: I really like the setup of your home office.
ex.zh: 我很喜歡你家裡辦公空間的配置。

ex.en: What's the setup for tomorrow's meeting room?
ex.zh: 明天會議室要怎麼佈置？

setup.en: the way that things are arranged or organized

ex.en: Market segmentation helps us target the right customers.
ex.zh: 市場區隔幫助我們鎖定對的客群。

ex.en: We use customer segmentation to plan our campaigns.
ex.zh: 我們用客群細分來規劃行銷活動。

segmentation.en: the act of dividing something into smaller groups or parts

ex.en: The seemingly simple task took all day.
ex.zh: 這個看似簡單的工作花了一整天。

ex.en: He was seemingly unaware of the problem.
ex.zh: 他似乎沒有察覺到這個問題。

seemingly.en: in a way that looks true but may not be

ex.en: The lights are controlled by a motion sensor.
ex.zh: 這些燈由動作感測器控制。

ex.en: The sensor detects changes in temperature.
ex.zh: 這個感測器會偵測溫度變化。

sensor.en: a device that finds and reacts to heat, light or movement

ex.en: The separatists demanded more autonomy.
ex.zh: 分離主義者要求更多的自治權。

ex.en: Talks between the government and the separatists failed.
ex.zh: 政府與分離主義者之間的談判破裂了。

separatist.en: a person who wants a region or group to become independent

ex.en: She is very selective about the jobs she applies for.
ex.zh: 她對要應徵的工作很挑剔。

ex.en: The university is highly selective.
ex.zh: 這所大學的錄取標準非常嚴格。

selective.en: choosing carefully and accepting only the best

ex.en: I found a bird whose wing was severely damaged.
ex.zh: 我發現一隻翅膀嚴重受傷的鳥。

ex.en: Their customer service is severely wanting.
ex.zh: 他們的客服品質非常差。

ex.en: The storm severely damaged the roof.
ex.zh: 暴風雨嚴重損壞了屋頂。

severely.en: in a very bad or serious way

ex.en: I got scolded severely by that teacher.
ex.zh: 我被那位老師狠狠罵了一頓。

ex.en: The teacher severely reprimanded his pupils.
ex.zh: 老師嚴厲地斥責了學生。

severely.en: in a very strict and hard way

ex.en: When I saw the picture, I remembered the story.
ex.zh: 我一看到那幅畫，就想起了那個故事。

ex.en: Did you see the email I sent?
ex.zh: 你有看到我寄的電子郵件嗎？

ex.en: We saw a great movie last night.
ex.zh: 我們昨晚看了一部很棒的電影。

see.en: to notice with your eyes, or to watch a film or show

ex.en: I look forward to seeing you again very soon.
ex.zh: 期待很快能再見到你。

ex.en: Had I arrived earlier, I could have seen Kelly.
ex.zh: 如果我早點到，就能見到凱莉了。

ex.en: You should see a doctor.
ex.zh: 你應該去看醫生。

see.en: to meet someone or visit them

ex.en: I see what you mean.
ex.zh: 我懂你的意思。

ex.en: "It's broken." "I see."
ex.zh: 「它壞了。」「原來如此。」

ex.en: Let me see if he's available.
ex.zh: 我看看他有沒有空。

ex.en: I'll see what I can do.
ex.zh: 我看看能幫上什麼忙。

ex.en: As a whole, the plan seems to be good.
ex.zh: 整體來看，這個計畫似乎不錯。

ex.en: It seemed that she had already received the money.
ex.zh: 她好像已經收到錢了。

ex.en: There seem to be several reasons for his failure.
ex.zh: 他失敗似乎有幾個原因。

seem.en: to give the feeling of being a certain way

set.zh: 設定、訂定（時間、目標、標準）

ex.en: This school sets high moral standards for pupils.
ex.zh: 這所學校對學生的品德要求很高。

ex.en: I set my alarm for six.
ex.zh: 我把鬧鐘設在六點。

set.en: to decide on a time, goal or rule

ex.en: You should set a good example to your children.
ex.zh: 你應該為孩子樹立好榜樣。

ex.en: Managers should set a good example.
ex.zh: 主管應該以身作則。

set.en: to behave in a way that others should copy

ex.en: The sun rises in the east and sets in the west.
ex.zh: 太陽從東方升起，從西方落下。

ex.en: The sun is setting.
ex.zh: 太陽下山了。

set.en: to go down below the horizon, as the sun does

ex.en: I bought a set of kitchen knives.
ex.zh: 我買了一套廚房刀具。

ex.en: This set includes four cups.
ex.zh: 這一組有四個杯子。

set.en: a group of things that belong together

ex.en: We set up a new office in Tainan.
ex.zh: 我們在台南設立了新辦公室。

ex.en: Can you help me set up the projector?
ex.zh: 你可以幫我架設投影機嗎？

set.en: to start something or put it in place

ex.en: The second button of your shirt is coming off.
ex.zh: 你襯衫的第二顆釦子快掉了。

ex.en: The accent in "guitar" falls on the second syllable.
ex.zh: 「guitar」這個字的重音在第二音節。

ex.en: There are sixty seconds in a minute.
ex.zh: 一分鐘有六十秒。

ex.en: The first airplane flew in 1903 for twelve seconds.
ex.zh: 世界上第一架飛機在1903年飛行了十二秒。

second.en: a very short unit of time, one sixtieth of a minute

ex.en: Wait a second.
ex.zh: 等一下。

ex.en: Do you have a second?
ex.zh: 你有空嗎？

ex.en: I second that idea.
ex.zh: 我贊成這個想法。

ex.en: Amy seconded the motion.
ex.zh: 艾咪附議了這項提案。

second.en: to formally support an idea made by another person in a meeting

ex.en: Thank you for sending me a nice card.
ex.zh: 謝謝你寄給我一張漂亮的卡片。

ex.en: She is curious to find who sent the flowers.
ex.zh: 她很想知道花是誰送來的。

ex.en: I'll send you the file by email.
ex.zh: 我會用電子郵件把檔案寄給你。

send.en: to make something go to another person or place

ex.en: They sent their son to Europe to acquire culture.
ex.zh: 他們把兒子送到歐洲去學習文化。

ex.en: The company sent me to Tokyo for training.
ex.zh: 公司派我去東京受訓。

send.en: to tell or arrange for a person to go somewhere

ex.en: Do you think we should send for the doctor?
ex.zh: 你覺得我們該請醫生來嗎？

ex.en: If her temperature goes up, send for the doctor.
ex.zh: 如果她的體溫上升，就請醫生來。

send.en: to ask for someone to come to you

ex.en: The temperature has been below freezing for several days.
ex.zh: 氣溫已經連續好幾天低於冰點。

ex.en: There seem to be several reasons for his failure.
ex.zh: 他失敗的原因似乎有好幾個。

ex.en: The linguist is fluent in several Chinese dialects.
ex.zh: 那位語言學家精通好幾種中國方言。

several.en: more than two but not many

ex.en: Several of my colleagues are sick.
ex.zh: 我有幾位同事生病了。

ex.en: I've read several of his books.
ex.zh: 他的書我讀過好幾本。

several.en: more than two people or things, but not many

ex.en: I have a strong sense of responsibility.
ex.zh: 我有很強的責任感。

ex.en: She has a great sense of humor.
ex.zh: 她很有幽默感。

sense.en: a feeling or understanding of something

ex.en: What you are saying does not make sense.
ex.zh: 你說的話沒道理。

ex.en: This idea is a misperception, and makes no sense.
ex.zh: 這個看法是錯覺，根本說不通。

sense.en: to be clear and easy to understand, or to be a good idea

ex.en: Sensing danger, he ran away.
ex.zh: 他察覺到危險就逃跑了。

ex.en: Mary senses the aliens are watching her.
ex.zh: 瑪麗感覺到外星人正在看著她。

sense.en: to feel or notice something without being told

ex.en: He finally came to his senses.
ex.zh: 他終於恢復理智了。

ex.en: Use your common sense.
ex.zh: 用你的常識判斷一下。

sense.en: the ability to think and act in a wise and practical way

ex.en: Why on earth did you sell your newly-built house?
ex.zh: 你到底為什麼把新蓋的房子賣掉？

ex.en: They were only interested in selling books.
ex.zh: 他們只對賣書感興趣。

ex.en: Without the slightest hesitation, he sold his own car.
ex.zh: 他毫不猶豫就把自己的車賣了。

sell.en: to give something to a person in return for money

ex.en: Do you know which book sells well now?
ex.zh: 你知道現在哪本書賣得好嗎？

ex.en: Strawberries sell for a high price in the winter.
ex.zh: 草莓在冬天賣得很貴。

sell.en: to be bought by customers in a certain way or at a certain price

ex.en: The concert tickets sold out in minutes.
ex.zh: 演唱會門票幾分鐘就賣光了。

ex.en: Sorry, we've sold out of that size.
ex.zh: 抱歉，那個尺寸已經賣完了。

sell.en: to be all bought so that none is left

ex.en: Hackers are adept at getting around computer security measures.
ex.zh: 駭客很擅長繞過電腦安全措施。

ex.en: Please get me hotel security.
ex.zh: 請幫我接飯店保全。

ex.en: Airport security was very tight.
ex.zh: 機場安檢非常嚴格。

security.en: protection against danger, crime or attack

ex.en: If you want security in your old age, begin saving now.
ex.zh: 如果你想要晚年有保障，現在就開始存錢。

ex.en: Germany adopted a social security system in the 1880's.
ex.zh: 德國在1880年代採用了社會安全制度。

security.en: the feeling of being safe and free from worry

ex.en: Please read section 3 of the contract.
ex.zh: 請閱讀合約的第三節。

ex.en: The report has four main sections.
ex.zh: 這份報告有四個主要部分。

section.en: one of the parts that something is divided into

ex.en: I would like to sit in the non-smoking section.
ex.zh: 我想坐在禁菸區。

ex.en: Do you have a non-smoking section?
ex.zh: 你們有禁菸區嗎？

section.en: a particular area of a place

ex.en: Who's in charge of the sales section?
ex.zh: 誰負責業務部門？

ex.en: Dad said he'd be promoted to section manager next year.
ex.zh: 爸爸說他明年會升為課長。

ex.en: There are seven men and four women in my section.
ex.zh: 我的部門有七男四女。

section.en: a part of a company or organization

ex.en: You need to seek help.
ex.zh: 你需要尋求協助。

ex.en: He sought shelter from the rain.
ex.zh: 他找地方避雨。

ex.en: Many graduates are seeking jobs in the tech industry.
ex.zh: 許多畢業生在科技業找工作。

seek.en: to look for or try to get something

ex.en: The factory waste gave rise to serious environmental pollution.
ex.zh: 工廠廢料造成了嚴重的環境汙染。

ex.en: He could not come because of his serious illness.
ex.zh: 他因為病得很重而不能來。

ex.en: I made a serious mistake on the test.
ex.zh: 我考試時犯了一個很嚴重的錯誤。

ex.en: We are having a serious talk about your future.
ex.zh: 我們正在認真談你的未來。

ex.en: I was serious when I said I love you.
ex.zh: 我說我愛你是認真的。

serious.en: not joking, and thinking carefully about something

ex.en: I left home early to get a good seat.
ex.zh: 我提早出門，想搶個好位子。

ex.en: The seats in the library are all taken again.
ex.zh: 圖書館的座位又都被佔滿了。

ex.en: Have you already booked our seats on a plane?
ex.zh: 你已經訂好我們的機位了嗎？

seat.en: something you can sit on, or a place where you can sit

ex.en: Please remain seated for a few minutes.
ex.zh: 請留在座位上幾分鐘。

ex.en: Please be seated.
ex.zh: 請就座。

seat.en: to sit down, or to help someone to sit down

ex.en: The police is searching for an escaped prisoner.
ex.zh: 警方正在搜捕一名逃犯。

ex.en: The rescue worker searched the area, looking for the child.
ex.zh: 救難人員搜遍了那個區域，尋找那個孩子。

ex.en: We spread out and began to search through the woods.
ex.zh: 我們分散開來並在樹林中展開搜尋。

search.en: to look carefully for something or someone

ex.en: I was searched by the customs officers at the airport.
ex.zh: 我在機場被海關人員搜查。

ex.en: Security staff searched our bags at the entrance.
ex.zh: 保全人員在入口檢查了我們的包包。

search.en: to check a person or place carefully for something hidden

ex.en: The police said the search for Tom will continue.
ex.zh: 警方表示，對湯姆的搜尋工作將持續進行。

ex.en: A quick online search gave me the answer.
ex.zh: 在網路上快速搜尋一下就找到答案了。

search.en: an attempt to find something or someone

ex.en: How far is it from here to the sea?
ex.zh: 從這裡到海邊有多遠？

ex.en: One day in July, we went to the sea.
ex.zh: 七月的某一天，我們去了海邊。

ex.en: The earth is made up of sea and land.
ex.zh: 地球是由海洋和陸地組成的。

sea.en: a large area of salt water

ex.en: Mary and Alice are a legally married same sex couple.
ex.zh: Mary 和 Alice 是一對合法結婚的同性伴侶。

ex.en: Please indicate your age and sex on the form.
ex.zh: 請在表格上填寫你的年齡和性別。

ex.en: The company does not discriminate on the basis of sex.
ex.zh: 這家公司不會因性別而有差別待遇。

sex.en: the state of being male or female

ex.en: Compare your sentence with the one on the blackboard.
ex.zh: 把你的句子和黑板上的句子比較一下。

ex.en: A sentence normally has a subject and a verb.
ex.zh: 句子通常有主詞和動詞。

ex.en: Please write a sentence using this word.
ex.zh: 請用這個字造一個句子。

sentence.en: a group of words that makes a complete statement

ex.en: He received a five-year prison sentence.
ex.zh: 他被判處五年徒刑。

ex.en: The judge will announce the sentence tomorrow.
ex.zh: 法官明天會宣判。

sentence.en: the punishment a judge gives to someone

ex.en: The judge sentenced him to one year's imprisonment.
ex.zh: 法官判他一年徒刑。

ex.en: In July 2004, Sami was sentenced to 24 years in jail.
ex.zh: 2004 年 7 月，薩米被判處 24 年徒刑。

sentence.en: to say officially what punishment a criminal will get

ex.en: She has worked in the financial sector for ten years.
ex.zh: 她在金融業工作十年了。

ex.en: The technology sector is growing quickly in Taiwan.
ex.zh: 台灣的科技產業成長得很快。

sector.en: a part of the economy or of a country's activity

sector.zh: public / private sector：公部門／民間部門

ex.en: Algeria needs to train its public sector employees on new technologies, communication skills, and customer service.
ex.zh: 阿爾及利亞需要訓練公部門員工新科技、溝通技巧和客服。

ex.en: He left the public sector to join a private company.
ex.zh: 他離開公部門，加入一家民間公司。

sector.en: the part of the economy run by the government or by private companies

ex.en: Please select a language for the Image Viewer interface.
ex.zh: 請為 Image Viewer 的介面選擇語言。

ex.en: He selected a Christmas gift for her.
ex.zh: 他為她挑了一份聖誕禮物。

ex.en: Tom was selected.
ex.zh: 湯姆被選上了。

select.en: to choose one or more things from a group

ex.en: The offer is available at select stores only.
ex.zh: 這項優惠僅限部分門市。

ex.en: Only a select group of customers was invited.
ex.zh: 只有一小群特選顧客受到邀請。

select.en: chosen carefully because of being the best or special

ex.en: The new secretary types about 70 words per minute.
ex.zh: 新來的秘書每分鐘大約打七十個字。

ex.en: Her name is Mary, she is my secretary.
ex.zh: 她叫瑪麗，是我的秘書。

ex.en: There is a position available for a secretary.
ex.zh: 有一個秘書職缺。

secretary.en: a person who writes letters, answers calls and organizes work for a boss

ex.en: The Secretary of State will visit Japan next week.
ex.zh: 美國國務卿下週將訪問日本。

ex.en: The Treasury Secretary spoke about the economy.
ex.zh: 財政部長談到了經濟情勢。

secretary.en: a high-level official in charge of a government department

ex.en: She was promoted to senior manager.
ex.zh: 她被升為資深經理。

ex.en: He is a senior engineer at the company.
ex.zh: 他是公司的資深工程師。

senior.en: having a high position in a company or organization

senior.zh: 年長的；（senior to）比…年長、職位高

ex.en: John is senior to me by two years.
ex.zh: 約翰比我大兩歲。

ex.en: George is five years senior to me.
ex.zh: 喬治比我大五歲。

ex.en: She gave her seat to a senior citizen.
ex.zh: 她把座位讓給一位長者。

senior.en: older, or higher in rank than someone else

senior.zh: 長者；（高中、大學）畢業班學生

ex.en: He is my senior by two years.
ex.zh: 他比我大兩歲。

ex.en: Seniors get a discount on bus tickets.
ex.zh: 長者搭公車享有優惠。

senior.en: an older person, or a student in the last year of high school or college

ex.en: Tom talked too much and let the secret slip.
ex.zh: 湯姆話太多，不小心洩露了祕密。

ex.en: Such secrets are always eventually revealed.
ex.zh: 這種祕密終究會被揭穿。

ex.en: I have no secrets from you.
ex.zh: 我對你沒有任何祕密。

secret.en: a piece of information that is kept hidden from others

ex.en: What's the secret of your success?
ex.zh: 你成功的祕訣是什麼？

ex.en: The secret to good coffee is fresh beans.
ex.zh: 好咖啡的祕訣在於新鮮的咖啡豆。

secret.en: the best or only way to achieve something

ex.en: Mary was concerned that Oliver had a secret girlfriend.
ex.zh: 瑪麗擔心奧利佛有個祕密女友。

ex.en: The company kept the new product secret until the launch.
ex.zh: 公司在發表前一直對新產品保密。

ex.en: They made a great effort to settle the problem.
ex.zh: 他們費了很大的力氣解決這個問題。

ex.en: The matter has not been settled yet.
ex.zh: 這件事還沒解決。

settle.en: to end an argument or deal with a problem

ex.en: Members of that tribe settled along the river.
ex.zh: 那個部落的成員沿著河岸定居。

ex.en: I need to settle in here first.
ex.zh: 我得先在這裡安頓下來。

settle.en: to make a home in a new place

ex.en: Please settle your bill before you check out.
ex.zh: 退房前請先結清帳單。

ex.en: We need to settle the account by Friday.
ex.zh: 我們必須在星期五前結清帳款。

settle.en: to pay money that is owed

ex.en: Alright, let's settle on that one!
ex.zh: 好，就決定選那個吧！

ex.en: We finally settled on a date for the wedding.
ex.zh: 我們終於決定了婚禮的日期。

settle.en: to choose something after thinking about different choices

ex.en: This bridge looks secure.
ex.zh: 這座橋看起來很穩固。

ex.en: Keep your password in a secure place.
ex.zh: 把你的密碼放在安全的地方。

secure.en: safe, firm and not likely to fall or break

ex.en: I feel secure with him.
ex.zh: 和他在一起我很有安全感。

ex.en: He has a secure job at a big bank.
ex.zh: 他在一家大銀行有份穩定的工作。

secure.en: feeling safe and free from worry

ex.en: We finally secured a contract with the client.
ex.zh: 我們終於和那位客戶簽下合約。

ex.en: The team secured funding for the project.
ex.zh: 團隊為這個專案爭取到了資金。

secure.en: to succeed in getting something important

ex.en: The bank secured the city from a flood.
ex.zh: 堤防保護城市免受水患。

ex.en: Make sure the boxes are secured before you drive.
ex.zh: 開車前要確認箱子都固定好了。

secure.en: to fasten something firmly, or to keep it safe

session.zh: （一段）活動時間；一堂課、一場會議

ex.en: I'll keep the meeting notes to review them before the next session.
ex.zh: 我會留著會議筆記，在下次開會前複習。

ex.en: The training session will last two hours.
ex.zh: 這堂訓練課程為時兩小時。

ex.en: We had a long brainstorming session this morning.
ex.zh: 我們今天早上開了一場很長的腦力激盪會議。

session.en: a period of time used for a particular activity

ex.en: Are you taking tests on the next session?
ex.zh: 下學期你要參加考試嗎？

ex.en: The court is now in session.
ex.zh: 法庭現在開庭。

session.en: a period when a school, court or law-making group meets regularly

ex.en: He was seriously injured in a traffic accident.
ex.zh: 他在一場車禍中受了重傷。

ex.en: The building was seriously damaged in the earthquake.
ex.zh: 這棟建築在地震中嚴重受損。

ex.en: You should take your health seriously.
ex.zh: 你應該認真看待自己的健康。

ex.en: He takes his job very seriously.
ex.zh: 他對工作非常認真。

seriously.en: in a careful way, without joking

ex.en: Seriously though, episode 21 made me almost cry while laughing.
ex.zh: 不過說真的，第 21 集讓我笑到差點哭出來。

ex.en: I'm seriously too busy, so I can't come tonight.
ex.zh: 我真的太忙了，今晚沒辦法來。

ex.en: Seriously? You lost your phone again?
ex.zh: 真的假的？你又把手機弄丟了？

seriously.en: used to show that you are not joking

ex.en: The company has a strict policy against sexual harassment.
ex.zh: 公司對性騷擾有嚴格的規範。

ex.en: Sexual harassment in the workplace is illegal.
ex.zh: 職場性騷擾是違法的。

sexual.en: related to the physical activity between people or to being male or female

ex.en: The selection of the new manager took three months.
ex.zh: 新經理的遴選花了三個月。

ex.en: Careful selection of suppliers is very important.
ex.zh: 謹慎挑選供應商非常重要。

selection.en: the act of choosing someone or something

ex.en: The store has a wide selection of shoes.
ex.zh: 這家店的鞋子選擇很多。

ex.en: We offer a selection of local wines.
ex.zh: 我們提供多款精選在地葡萄酒。

selection.en: a group of things from which you can choose

ex.en: The two companies reached a settlement.
ex.zh: 兩家公司達成了和解。

ex.en: They agreed to an out-of-court settlement.
ex.zh: 他們同意庭外和解。

settlement.en: an official agreement that ends an argument

ex.en: Please send the payment in settlement of the invoice.
ex.zh: 請付款以結清這張發票。

ex.en: Final settlement of the account is due next week.
ex.zh: 帳款最後結算的期限是下週。

settlement.en: the payment of money that is owed

ex.en: On this small island are two large towns and many small settlements.
ex.zh: 這座小島上有兩座大城鎮和許多小聚落。

ex.en: The settlement was founded over 300 years ago.
ex.zh: 這個聚落建立於三百多年前。

settlement.en: a small town or group of homes in a new or distant area

ex.en: They eat melon seeds while they play cards.
ex.zh: 他們一邊嗑瓜子一邊打牌。

ex.en: Plant the seeds in early spring.
ex.zh: 在初春時播下種子。

seed.en: a small hard part of a plant from which a new plant can grow

ex.en: The incident sowed the seeds of the war.
ex.zh: 這起事件埋下了戰爭的種子。

ex.en: His comment planted a seed of doubt in her mind.
ex.zh: 他的話在她心裡埋下了懷疑的種子。

seed.en: the start of something that will grow bigger later

ex.en: She seeded vegetables in her garden.
ex.zh: 她在菜園裡種了一些蔬菜。

ex.en: The farmers seeded the field with corn.
ex.zh: 農夫們在田裡播下了玉米種子。

seed.en: to put small hard plant parts into the ground so they grow

ex.en: Our team is seeded in the ping-pong competition.
ex.zh: 我們隊是這次桌球比賽的種子隊。

ex.en: She is seeded third in the tournament.
ex.zh: 她在這次錦標賽中被列為第三號種子。

seed.en: to place a player in a high position in a competition because of their skill

self.zh: 自我、本性；（某時期的）樣子

ex.en: She's finally back to her old self.
ex.zh: 她終於恢復成原來的樣子了。

ex.en: You should always be your true self.
ex.zh: 你應該永遠做真正的自己。

self.en: the type of person you are, or how you are at a certain time

ex.en: Secondly, is there any project scheduled to be released today?
ex.zh: 第二，今天有預定要發布的專案嗎？

ex.en: Firstly, it's too expensive; secondly, it's too slow.
ex.zh: 第一，它太貴；第二，它太慢。

ex.en: Secondly, we need to hire more staff.
ex.zh: 其次，我們需要招募更多員工。

secondly.en: used to introduce the next point after the first

ex.en: Japan is confronted with severe economic problems.
ex.zh: 日本正面臨嚴重的經濟問題。

ex.en: The blizzard has already had a severe impact on the economy.
ex.zh: 這場暴風雪已經對經濟造成嚴重衝擊。

ex.en: In severe weather, it's best to stay indoors.
ex.zh: 天氣惡劣時最好待在室內。

ex.en: He was severe with his children.
ex.zh: 他對自己的孩子很嚴格。

ex.en: The company faces severe penalties for breaking the rules.
ex.zh: 這家公司違規將面臨嚴厲的處罰。

ex.en: Please arrange the files in sequence.
ex.zh: 請按照順序整理這些檔案。

ex.en: Follow the steps in the correct sequence.
ex.zh: 請依正確順序執行步驟。

sequence.en: the order in which things come

sequence.zh: 一連串、一系列；（電影）片段

ex.en: A sequence of events led to the delay.
ex.zh: 一連串的事件導致了延誤。

ex.en: The opening sequence of the movie is amazing.
ex.zh: 這部電影的開場片段非常精彩。

sequence.en: a number of things or events that follow one another

ex.en: Cats' eyes are very sensitive to light.
ex.zh: 貓的眼睛對光非常敏感。

ex.en: You are too sensitive to criticism.
ex.zh: 你對批評太敏感了。

ex.en: Is this tooth sensitive to cold food?
ex.zh: 這顆牙齒對冰冷的食物會敏感嗎？

sensitive.en: quick to react to something, or easily affected by it

ex.en: Please do not share sensitive information by email.
ex.zh: 請不要用電子郵件傳送機密資訊。

ex.en: Salary is a sensitive topic in many offices.
ex.zh: 在很多公司，薪水是個敏感話題。

sensitive.en: secret or likely to upset people

ex.en: Tom and I go to the same secondary school.
ex.zh: 我和湯姆念同一所中學。

ex.en: We went to a secondary school to invigilate today.
ex.zh: 我們今天去一所中學監考。

secondary.en: for students between about eleven and eighteen years old

ex.en: Must the woman always play the secondary role?
ex.zh: 女性難道永遠只能扮演次要角色嗎？

ex.en: Price is a secondary concern; quality comes first.
ex.zh: 價格是次要考量，品質才是第一。

ex.en: This mask completely seals your face.
ex.zh: 這個面罩能完全密合你的臉。

ex.en: Seal the envelope before you mail it.
ex.zh: 寄出前把信封封好。

ex.en: The food is sealed in airtight bags.
ex.zh: 食物用密封袋封裝。

seal.en: to close something tightly so nothing can get in or out

ex.en: Do not use the product if the seal is broken.
ex.zh: 如果封條破損，請勿使用本產品。

ex.en: The document has an official seal.
ex.zh: 這份文件蓋有官方印章。

seal.en: a piece of paper or wax that shows something is closed, or an official mark

ex.en: We saw seals resting on the rocks.
ex.zh: 我們看到海豹在岩石上休息。

ex.en: Seals are excellent swimmers.
ex.zh: 海豹很會游泳。

seal.en: a sea animal with smooth fur that eats fish

ex.en: This segment of the market is growing fast.
ex.zh: 這個市場區塊成長得很快。

ex.en: The TV show has a short cooking segment.
ex.zh: 這個電視節目有一段簡短的烹飪單元。

segment.en: one of the parts that something is divided into

ex.en: We segment our customers by age.
ex.zh: 我們依年齡區隔客群。

ex.en: The market can be segmented into three groups.
ex.zh: 這個市場可以分成三個族群。

segment.en: to divide something into smaller parts

ex.en: Even his servants despised him.
ex.zh: 連他的僕人都看不起他。

ex.en: The rich family had several servants.
ex.zh: 那個有錢人家有好幾個傭人。

servant.en: a person who works in someone's home, cooking and cleaning for them

ex.en: My father is a civil servant.
ex.zh: 我爸爸是公務員。

ex.en: Public servants should serve the people.
ex.zh: 公務員應該為人民服務。

servant.en: a person who works for the government

ex.en: Sweat glands secrete sweat to cool the body.
ex.zh: 汗腺分泌汗水來讓身體降溫。

ex.en: The stomach secretes acid to digest food.
ex.zh: 胃會分泌胃酸來消化食物。

secrete.en: to produce a liquid in the body

ex.en: He secreted the money in a drawer.
ex.zh: 他把錢藏在抽屜裡。

ex.en: She secreted the letter inside a book.
ex.zh: 她把信藏在一本書裡。

secrete.en: to hide something in a hidden place

ex.en: The river carries sediment to the sea.
ex.zh: 河流把沉積物帶到海裡。

ex.en: There was some sediment at the bottom of the bottle.
ex.zh: 瓶底有一些沉澱物。

sediment.en: tiny pieces of solid material that sink to the bottom of a liquid

ex.en: The two words have a slight semantic difference.
ex.zh: 這兩個字在語意上有些微差異。

ex.en: Search engines use semantic analysis to understand queries.
ex.zh: 搜尋引擎用語意分析來理解查詢內容。

semantic.en: related to the meaning of words

ex.en: I felt a burning sensation in my throat.
ex.zh: 我覺得喉嚨有灼熱感。

ex.en: She lost all sensation in her left hand.
ex.zh: 她的左手完全失去了知覺。

ex.en: The hair style of the Beatles created a sensation.
ex.zh: 披頭四的髮型引起了轟動。

ex.en: The new phone caused a sensation in the market.
ex.zh: 這款新手機在市場上引起轟動。

sensation.en: a person or event that causes great excitement

ex.en: Babies learn through sensory experiences.
ex.zh: 嬰兒透過感官經驗來學習。

ex.en: Too much noise can cause sensory overload.
ex.zh: 噪音太多可能造成感官超載。

sensory.en: related to the body's ability to see, hear, smell, taste and touch

ex.en: Sex education covers topics such as sexuality and health.
ex.zh: 性教育涵蓋性與健康等主題。

ex.en: The book discusses gender and sexuality.
ex.zh: 這本書探討性別與性取向。

sexuality.en: a person's physical feelings of attraction, or the kind of people they are attracted to

ex.en: They sleep in separate bedrooms even though they're married.
ex.zh: 他們雖然結婚了，卻分房睡。

ex.en: Please keep the receipts in a separate folder.
ex.zh: 請把收據放在另一個資料夾。

separate.en: not joined, and apart from each other

ex.en: A sea separates Ireland and England.
ex.zh: 愛爾蘭和英格蘭之間隔著一片海。

ex.en: My home is separated from his by a river.
ex.zh: 我家和他家隔著一條河。

ex.en: In our city, we carefully separate and collect garbage.
ex.zh: 在我們的城市，大家都會仔細做垃圾分類。

separate.en: to keep things or people apart

ex.en: Her parents separated when she was ten.
ex.zh: 她十歲時父母就分居了。

ex.en: They separated but never got divorced.
ex.zh: 他們分居了，但一直沒有離婚。

separate.en: to stop living together as a couple

ex.en: Is there a service charge for that?
ex.zh: 這要收服務費嗎？

ex.en: The bill includes a 10% service charge.
ex.zh: 帳單包含一成服務費。

service charge.en: an extra amount of money added to a bill for the work of staff

ex.en: Office workers often have a sedentary lifestyle.
ex.zh: 上班族常常過著久坐不動的生活。

ex.en: A sedentary job can cause back problems.
ex.zh: 久坐的工作可能導致背部問題。

sedentary.en: spending a lot of time sitting down, with little exercise

ex.en: Lucario is a creature in the Pokémon series.
ex.zh: 路卡利歐是《寶可夢》系列中的一種寶可夢。

ex.en: I'm watching a Korean drama series on Netflix.
ex.zh: 我在 Netflix 上追一部韓劇。

series.en: a set of television or radio programs about the same people or subject

ex.en: A series of blasts reduced the laboratory to ruins.
ex.zh: 一連串的爆炸使實驗室成為廢墟。

ex.en: They conducted a series of experiments under zero gravity.
ex.zh: 他們在無重力狀態下進行了一連串的實驗。

ex.en: He has just published an interesting series of articles.
ex.zh: 他剛發表了一系列有趣的文章。

series.en: a number of similar things that come one after another

ex.en: The sequel was even better than the first movie.
ex.zh: 續集比第一集還好看。

ex.en: The author is writing a sequel to her best-selling novel.
ex.zh: 作者正在寫她暢銷小說的續集。

sequel.en: a book or film that continues the story of an earlier one

ex.en: I like spring the best of the seasons.
ex.zh: 春天是我最喜歡的季節。

ex.en: Which season do you like best, spring or autumn?
ex.zh: 春天和秋天，你比較喜歡哪個季節？

season.en: one of the four parts of the year, such as summer or winter

ex.en: Kyoto is packed with people during the holiday season.
ex.zh: 假期期間，京都人山人海。

ex.en: Hotels are expensive during the tourist season.
ex.zh: 觀光旺季時飯店都很貴。

season.en: a period of the year when something happens or is popular

ex.en: I seasoned the fish with salt and pepper.
ex.zh: 我用鹽和胡椒幫魚調味。

ex.en: Season the soup with a little salt.
ex.zh: 用一點鹽幫湯調味。

season.en: to add salt, spices or herbs to food to give it more taste

ex.en: It seems to me that she is a little selfish.
ex.zh: 我覺得她有點自私。

ex.en: It is true that she is pretty, but she is selfish.
ex.zh: 她確實很漂亮，但她很自私。

ex.en: She is a selfish person.
ex.zh: 她是一個自私的人。

selfish.en: caring only about yourself and not about other people

ex.en: The poet's sensibility to nature shows in every line.
ex.zh: 詩人對自然的敏銳感受力呈現在每一行詩句中。

ex.en: Her artistic sensibility made her a fine designer.
ex.zh: 她的藝術感受力使她成為出色的設計師。

sensibility.en: the ability to feel and understand deep emotions, art or beauty

ex.en: He keeps the old letters for sentimental reasons.
ex.zh: 他因為情感上的原因留著那些舊信。

ex.en: She gets sentimental whenever she hears that song.
ex.zh: 她一聽到那首歌就變得多愁善感。

sentimental.en: showing or caused by tender feelings, such as love or sadness for the past

self-explanatory.zh: 不言自明的、一看就懂的

ex.en: The instructions are self-explanatory, so you won't need any help.
ex.zh: 說明一看就懂，所以你不需要別人幫忙。

ex.en: Most of the items on the form are self-explanatory.
ex.zh: 表格上大部分項目都不用解釋就看得懂。

self-explanatory.en: easy to understand without any extra explanation

ex.en: The wound became septic because it was not cleaned properly.
ex.zh: 傷口因為沒有好好清潔而感染化膿了。

ex.en: Doctors treated her for septic shock in the intensive care unit.
ex.zh: 醫生在加護病房為她治療敗血性休克。

ex.en: The hospital gave him serum after the snake bite.
ex.zh: 他被蛇咬後，醫院為他注射了血清。

ex.en: The lab tested the blood serum for signs of infection.
ex.zh: 實驗室檢驗血清，看看有沒有感染的跡象。

serum.en: the clear liquid part of blood, or a medicine made from it

ex.en: The small religious sect lives in the mountains far from the city.
ex.zh: 這個小教派住在遠離城市的山區。

ex.en: Buddhism has many sects with different teachings.
ex.zh: 佛教有許多教義各不相同的宗派。

sect.en: a small group with its own beliefs, often split from a larger religion

ex.en: Many shoppers are seduced by big discounts they don't really need.
ex.zh: 許多購物者被其實不需要的大折扣誘惑。

ex.en: The promise of easy money seduced him into a bad decision.
ex.zh: 輕鬆賺錢的誘惑讓他做了錯誤的決定。

seduce.en: to attract someone and make them do something they would not normally do

ex.en: The early settlers built their homes near the river.
ex.zh: 早期的移居者把房子蓋在河邊。

ex.en: The settlers shared food with each other during the long winter.
ex.zh: 那些開拓者在漫長的冬天裡互相分享食物。

settler.en: a person who goes to live in a new place where few people live

ex.en: In the past, some schools segregated students by race.
ex.zh: 過去有些學校依種族把學生隔離開來。

ex.en: Please segregate the recyclables from the regular trash.
ex.zh: 請把可回收物和一般垃圾分開。

segregate.en: to keep one group of people apart from another

ex.en: The newspaper was criticized for its sensationalism.
ex.zh: 這家報紙因為煽情報導而受到批評。

ex.en: Good journalism avoids sensationalism.
ex.zh: 好的新聞報導會避免譁眾取寵。

sensationalism.en: the use of shocking stories to get people's attention

ex.en: Pretty good. Did you go to today's history seminar?
ex.zh: 還不錯。你去了今天的歷史研討課嗎？

ex.en: How was the seminar?
ex.zh: 研討會怎麼樣？

seminar.en: a meeting where a small group discusses or studies a subject

ex.en: This restaurant serves French cuisine, but with Japanese tableware.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳供應法式料理，但用的是日式餐具。

ex.en: Although I had ordered tea, he served me coffee.
ex.zh: 雖然我點的是茶，他卻給我上了咖啡。

ex.en: The takoyaki served at this restaurant is a delight.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳的章魚燒很好吃。

serve.en: to give food or drink to people at a meal

ex.en: I'll be very happy if I can serve you.
ex.zh: 能為您服務，我會非常高興。

ex.en: She served in the army for two years.
ex.zh: 她在軍中服役兩年。

serve.en: to work for someone or help them

ex.en: All these things serve to add to our happiness.
ex.zh: 這些都能讓我們更幸福。

ex.en: The accident served as a warning to all drivers.
ex.zh: 這場意外對所有駕駛都是一個警惕。

serve.en: to have a certain purpose or effect

ex.en: The service in this restaurant is none too fast.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳的服務一點也不快。

ex.en: Some national parks offer showers and even baby-sitting services.
ex.zh: 有些國家公園設有淋浴間，甚至還會提供托兒服務。

service.en: work done to help customers, or the way staff treat them

ex.en: There is an air service between Tokyo and Moscow.
ex.zh: 東京和莫斯科之間有航班往來。

ex.en: Train service will resume tomorrow morning.
ex.zh: 火車明天早上恢復行駛。

service.en: a system that provides something the public needs, such as transport

ex.en: By coincidence, these two are still being serviced.
ex.zh: 真巧，這兩台目前都還在維修。

ex.en: I need to get my car serviced.
ex.zh: 我的車需要送去保養。

service.en: to check a machine and repair it so it works well

ex.en: Promotion decisions consider performance and seniority.
ex.zh: 升遷決定會考量績效與年資。

ex.en: Her seniority gives her priority when choosing shifts.
ex.zh: 她的年資讓她在選擇班別時享有優先權。

seniority.en: the length of time someone has worked somewhere, or a higher rank because of this

ex.en: The seaport handles thousands of containers each month.
ex.zh: 這座海港每月處理數千個貨櫃。

ex.en: A new road will connect the factory to the seaport.
ex.zh: 新道路將連接工廠與海港。

seaport.en: a town or harbor where ships load and unload goods and passengers

ex.en: The broker specializes in government securities.
ex.zh: 這名經紀人專營政府有價證券。

ex.en: Investors moved their securities to a safer account.
ex.zh: 投資人將金融商品轉到較安全的帳戶。

securities.en: financial documents, such as stocks and bonds, that can be bought and sold

ex.en: The software performs the tasks in sequential order.
ex.zh: 軟體會依序執行各項工作。

ex.en: Please follow the sequential steps in the guide.
ex.zh: 請依照指南中的步驟順序操作。

sequential.en: happening one after another in a fixed order

ex.en: The factory produces semiconductor chips for cars.
ex.zh: 這座工廠為汽車生產半導體晶片。

ex.en: Demand for semiconductor equipment remains strong.
ex.zh: 半導體設備的需求仍然強勁。

semiconductor.en: a material that carries electricity only a little, used to make computer chips

ex.en: Several passengers felt seasick during the rough crossing.
ex.zh: 海象不佳，幾位乘客在航行途中感到暈船。

ex.en: She took medicine before boarding because she gets seasick easily.
ex.zh: 她很容易暈船，因此登船前先吃了藥。

seasick.en: feeling sick because of the movement of a ship

ex.en: The venue offers accessible seating near the main entrance.
ex.zh: 場地在主要入口附近設有無障礙座位。

ex.en: Please confirm the seating arrangement before printing the program.
ex.zh: 印製節目單前，請確認座位安排。

seating.en: the seats in a place, or the way they are arranged

ex.en: Add the seasoning just before serving the soup.
ex.zh: 上湯前再加入調味料。

ex.en: The chef adjusted the seasoning after tasting the sauce.
ex.zh: 主廚試過醬汁後調整了調味。

seasoning.en: salt, herbs or spices added to food to give it more taste

ex.en: Fasten your seat belt, please.
ex.zh: 請繫好安全帶。

ex.en: Tom would still be alive if he had been wearing his seat belt.
ex.zh: 要是湯姆繫上安全帶的話，他就不會死的。

ex.en: Fasten your seat belt at all times.
ex.zh: 請隨時繫好安全帶。

seat belt.en: a strap across your body that keeps you safe in a car or plane

ex.en: Employees who were laid off received severance pay.
ex.zh: 被裁員的員工拿到了資遣費。

ex.en: The company offered three months' severance.
ex.zh: 公司提供三個月的資遣費。

severance.en: money a company pays to a worker who has to leave the job

ex.en: The restaurant has a lovely setting by the river.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳位於河邊，環境優美。

ex.en: The story's setting is a small fishing village.
ex.zh: 這個故事的背景是一個小漁村。

ex.en: Change the setting to a lower temperature.
ex.zh: 把設定調成較低的溫度。

ex.en: Check the privacy settings on your phone.
ex.zh: 檢查一下你手機上的隱私設定。

ex.en: The sergeant gave orders to the new soldiers.
ex.zh: 士官向新兵下達命令。

ex.en: A police sergeant came to take our statements.
ex.zh: 一位警佐前來為我們做筆錄。

ex.en: One serving of this soup has only 80 calories.
ex.zh: 這種湯一份只有八十大卡。

ex.en: Would you like a second serving of rice?
ex.zh: 你想再來一份飯嗎？

ex.en: The serving of dinner begins at seven o'clock.
ex.zh: 晚餐七點開始上菜。

ex.en: Fast serving is important in a busy restaurant.
ex.zh: 在忙碌的餐廳裡，快速上菜很重要。

ex.en: The selected students will join the trip.
ex.zh: 被選中的學生將參加這趟旅行。

ex.en: The store sells selected products from local farms.
ex.zh: 這家店販售來自在地農場的精選商品。

ex.en: There are seven days in a week.
ex.zh: 一個星期有七天。

ex.en: I get home at seven every evening.
ex.zh: 我每天晚上七點到家。

ex.en: The little boy is seven years old.
ex.zh: 那個小男孩七歲了。

ex.en: The new school year begins in September.
ex.zh: 新學年從九月開始。

ex.en: My sister was born in September.
ex.zh: 我姊姊是九月出生的。

ex.en: The Mid-Autumn Festival is often in September.
ex.zh: 中秋節常常在九月。

senate.zh: 參議院、立法機構、評議會

ex.en: The Senate voted on the new law yesterday.
ex.zh: 參議院昨天針對新法律進行了投票。

ex.en: Each state elects two members to the US Senate.
ex.zh: 每個州選出兩位美國參議員。

ex.en: The university senate meets once a month.
ex.zh: 大學評議會每個月開一次會。

ex.en: My grandfather turns seventy next month.
ex.zh: 我爺爺下個月滿七十歲。

ex.en: The lake is about seventy kilometers from here.
ex.zh: 那座湖離這裡大約七十公里。

ex.en: Seventy students joined the school trip.
ex.zh: 有七十名學生參加了校外教學。

ex.en: My cousin turns seventeen next month.
ex.zh: 我表弟下個月就滿十七歲了。

ex.en: There are seventeen students in our class.
ex.zh: 我們班上有十七個學生。

ex.en: The bus leaves at seventeen minutes past nine.
ex.zh: 公車九點十七分開。

ex.en: She lives on the seventh floor of the building.
ex.zh: 她住在這棟大樓的七樓。

ex.en: Our team finished in seventh place this season.
ex.zh: 我們隊伍這個球季拿到第七名。

ex.en: My brother is in the seventh grade.
ex.zh: 我弟弟讀七年級。

selling.zh: 賣、銷售（sell 的現在分詞）

ex.en: He is selling his old bicycle online.
ex.zh: 他正在網路上賣他的舊腳踏車。

ex.en: The shop is selling fresh fruit at half price today.
ex.zh: 這家店今天把新鮮水果半價出售。

ex.en: Selling used books helped her earn some extra money.
ex.zh: 賣二手書讓她賺了一些額外的錢。

ex.en: He is good at selling, so he works in a sales team.
ex.zh: 他很擅長銷售，所以在業務團隊工作。

ex.en: My birthday is on the seventeenth of June.
ex.zh: 我的生日是六月十七日。

ex.en: The seventeenth century saw great advances in science.
ex.zh: 十七世紀的科學有很大的進展。

ex.en: He finished seventeenth in a race of fifty runners.
ex.zh: 在五十名選手的比賽中，他得了第十七名。

ex.en: The secretion of saliva helps us digest food.
ex.zh: 唾液的分泌幫助我們消化食物。

ex.en: The gland controls the secretion of hormones in the body.
ex.zh: 這個腺體控制身體荷爾蒙的分泌。

ex.en: She secretly planned a surprise party for her friend.
ex.zh: 她暗地裡為朋友籌劃了一場驚喜派對。

ex.en: He secretly hoped that the meeting would be canceled.
ex.zh: 他暗自希望會議能取消。

ex.en: The boy secretly kept a small kitten in his room.
ex.zh: 那個男孩偷偷在房間裡養了一隻小貓。

ex.en: We listened to a Serbian folk song at the festival.
ex.zh: 我們在慶典上聽了一首塞爾維亞民謠。

ex.en: The Serbian capital is Belgrade.
ex.zh: 塞爾維亞的首都是貝爾格勒。

ex.en: The plant cleans sewage before it goes into the river.
ex.zh: 這座工廠在汙水排入河川之前先加以處理。

ex.en: A broken pipe let sewage flow onto the street.
ex.zh: 一根破裂的管子讓汙水流到了街上。

ex.en: The priest gave a short sermon about kindness.
ex.zh: 神父講了一場關於善良的簡短佈道。

ex.en: I didn't come here to listen to a sermon.
ex.zh: 我來這裡不是為了聽你說教。

ex.en: The project was carried out in complete secrecy.
ex.zh: 這個專案是在完全保密的情況下進行的。

ex.en: They were sworn to secrecy and could not tell anyone.
ex.zh: 他們被要求保密，不能告訴任何人。

ex.en: Doctors judged the severity of his injuries immediately.
ex.zh: 醫生立刻評估了他傷勢的嚴重程度。

ex.en: The severity of the storm surprised everyone in town.
ex.zh: 這場暴風雨的嚴重程度讓鎮上每個人都很吃驚。

ex.en: The judge was known for the severity of his sentences.
ex.zh: 這位法官以判決嚴厲而聞名。

ex.en: She spoke with a severity that silenced the whole class.
ex.zh: 她說話的嚴厲語氣讓全班安靜下來。

ex.en: The seam of my jacket came apart at the shoulder.
ex.zh: 我外套肩膀的縫線裂開了。

ex.en: Water leaked through a seam in the old boat.
ex.zh: 水從舊船的一道接縫滲了進來。

ex.en: She seamed the two pieces of cloth together by hand.
ex.zh: 她用手把兩片布縫在一起。

ex.en: The tailor seamed the sleeves together before ironing them.
ex.zh: 裁縫師先把袖子縫合再熨燙。

ex.en: The old seaman told us stories about the ocean.
ex.zh: 老水手對我們講述海上的故事。

ex.en: Every seaman on board wore a life jacket during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨期間，船上每位船員都穿著救生衣。

ex.en: Losing the first game was a small setback for the team.
ex.zh: 輸掉第一場比賽對球隊來說是個小挫折。

ex.en: Despite the setback, she kept working toward her goal.
ex.zh: 儘管遭遇挫折，她仍繼續朝目標努力。

ex.en: The book explains how racial segregation affected schools.
ex.zh: 這本書說明種族隔離如何影響學校。

ex.en: The segregation of waste makes recycling easier.
ex.zh: 垃圾分類讓回收更容易。

ex.en: The boy had a seizure at school and was taken to the hospital.
ex.zh: 男孩在學校癲癇發作，被送往醫院。

ex.en: The doctor explained what to do if someone has a seizure.
ex.zh: 醫生解釋了有人癲癇發作時該怎麼做。

ex.en: The police announced the seizure of illegal goods at the port.
ex.zh: 警方宣布在港口查獲了違禁品。

ex.en: The seizure of the building by the army shocked the city.
ex.zh: 軍隊佔領這棟建築的事震驚了全市。

ex.en: He spoke with great seriousness about the problem.
ex.zh: 他非常嚴肅地談到這個問題。

ex.en: Nobody understood the seriousness of the situation at first.
ex.zh: 起初沒有人了解情況的嚴重性。

ex.en: He is a seasoned traveler who has visited fifty countries.
ex.zh: 他是個經驗豐富的旅行者，去過五十個國家。

ex.en: The team hired a seasoned coach to lead them.
ex.zh: 球隊聘請了一位經驗老到的教練來帶領他們。

ex.en: The chef served a perfectly seasoned steak.
ex.zh: 主廚端上一塊調味恰到好處的牛排。

ex.en: Add the seasoned rice to the bowl and mix well.
ex.zh: 把調好味的飯加進碗裡拌勻。

ex.en: Use the channel selector to switch to another station.
ex.zh: 用頻道選擇器切換到另一個電台。

ex.en: The camera has a mode selector on the top.
ex.zh: 這台相機頂部有個模式選擇器。

ex.en: Belgrade is the capital of Serbia.
ex.zh: 貝爾格勒是塞爾維亞的首都。

ex.en: They traveled through Serbia by train.
ex.zh: 他們搭火車穿越塞爾維亞。

ex.en: The storm severed the power lines.
ex.zh: 暴風雨切斷了電線。

ex.en: The country severed ties with its neighbor.
ex.zh: 這個國家與鄰國斷絕了關係。

ex.en: The newspaper printed a sensational story about the scandal.
ex.zh: 報紙刊登了一則關於醜聞的聳動報導。

ex.en: The sensational news spread across the country in hours.
ex.zh: 這則轟動的消息在幾小時內傳遍全國。

ex.en: The singer gave a sensational performance last night.
ex.zh: 那位歌手昨晚的表演精彩極了。

ex.en: You look sensational in that blue dress!
ex.zh: 你穿那件藍色洋裝美呆了！

ex.en: Water began to seep through the cracks in the wall.
ex.zh: 水開始從牆上的裂縫滲出來。

ex.en: The smell of coffee seeped into the hallway.
ex.zh: 咖啡的香味飄進了走廊。

ex.en: Rainwater seeped into the basement.
ex.zh: 雨水滲進了地下室。

ex.en: She sensibly saved part of her salary every month.
ex.zh: 她明智地每個月存下一部分薪水。

ex.en: Let's sit down and discuss this sensibly.
ex.zh: 我們坐下來理智地討論這件事吧。

ex.en: Keep the cookies in a sealed container to stay fresh.
ex.zh: 把餅乾放在密封容器裡才能保持新鮮。

ex.en: He handed me a sealed envelope.
ex.zh: 他遞給我一個封好的信封。

ex.en: She sealed the box with tape.

ex.en: I am sensing that something is wrong with him today.
ex.zh: 我感覺他今天有些不對勁。

ex.en: A searcher found the lost hiker's backpack near the river.
ex.zh: 一名搜尋人員在河邊找到那名迷路登山客的背包。

ex.en: Every searcher received a map and a radio.
ex.zh: 每位搜尋者都拿到一張地圖和一台無線電。

ex.en: Many people believe that animals are sentient beings.
ex.zh: 許多人相信動物是有感知能力的生命。

ex.en: The film is about a sentient robot that learns to feel.
ex.zh: 這部電影講的是一個學會感受的有意識機器人。

ex.en: The teacher is separating the students into small groups.
ex.zh: 老師正在把學生分成幾個小組。

ex.en: A thin wall is separating the kitchen from the living room.
ex.zh: 一道薄牆把廚房和客廳隔開。

ex.en: A medieval serf worked the land of a lord.
ex.zh: 中世紀的農奴為領主耕種土地。

ex.en: Serfs were not free to leave the estate where they lived.
ex.zh: 農奴不能自由離開自己居住的莊園。

ex.en: The setter placed each stone carefully in the wall.
ex.zh: 砌石工人小心地把每塊石頭嵌入牆裡。

ex.en: In volleyball, the setter passes the ball to the hitter.
ex.zh: 在排球中，舉球員會把球傳給攻擊手。

ex.en: Our neighbor has a red setter that loves to run.
ex.zh: 我們鄰居養了一隻愛跑步的紅色塞特犬。

ex.en: The setter found the bird hiding in the grass.
ex.zh: 塞特犬找到了藏在草叢裡的鳥。

ex.en: Senegal is a country in West Africa.
ex.zh: 塞內加爾是西非的一個國家。

ex.en: The capital of Senegal is Dakar.
ex.zh: 塞內加爾的首都是達卡。

ex.en: Some states chose to secede from the union.
ex.zh: 有些州選擇脫離聯邦。

ex.en: The region voted to secede and form its own country.
ex.zh: 該地區投票決定脫離並成立自己的國家。

sedimentary.zh: 沉積的；由沉積物形成的

ex.en: Limestone is a kind of sedimentary rock.
ex.zh: 石灰岩是一種沉積岩。

ex.en: Sedimentary layers can show how old a rock formation is.
ex.zh: 沉積層可以顯示一個岩層有多古老。

ex.en: Sedimentation at the river mouth created a new island.
ex.zh: 河口的沉積作用形成了一座新島。

ex.en: The water plant uses sedimentation to remove dirt.
ex.zh: 淨水廠利用沉澱來去除髒汙。

ex.en: The jury was sequestered during the long trial.
ex.zh: 陪審團在冗長的審判期間被隔離。

ex.en: He sequestered himself in his study to finish the book.
ex.zh: 他把自己關在書房裡完成那本書。

ex.en: The motion passed because it had a proposer and a seconder.
ex.zh: 這項動議有提案人和附議者，所以通過了。

ex.en: Who will be the seconder of her proposal?
ex.zh: 誰會是她提案的附議人？

ex.en: The movie was criticized for its sentimentality.
ex.zh: 這部電影因為過度煽情而受到批評。

ex.en: He kept the old toy out of pure sentimentality.
ex.zh: 他純粹出於多愁善感而留著那個舊玩具。

ex.en: There was no room for sentimentality in her business decisions.
ex.zh: 她做生意決策時不容許多愁善感。

ex.en: The seamstress shortened the dress to fit her perfectly.
ex.zh: 女裁縫把洋裝改短，讓它非常合身。

ex.en: My aunt worked as a seamstress for many years.
ex.zh: 我阿姨當了很多年的女裁縫。

ex.en: The dress was covered in tiny silver sequins.
ex.zh: 那件洋裝綴滿了小小的銀色亮片。

ex.en: She sewed a sequin onto the costume.
ex.zh: 她把一片亮片縫到戲服上。

ex.en: The Sejm is the lower house of the Polish parliament.
ex.zh: 色姆是波蘭國會的下議院。

ex.en: Members of the Sejm met in Warsaw to vote on the law.
ex.zh: 色姆的議員在華沙集會，就該法案進行表決。

ex.en: He is running in the senatorial election.
ex.zh: 他正在參加參議員選舉。

ex.en: The senatorial committee will meet on Monday.
ex.zh: 參議院委員會將在週一開會。

ex.en: The seer warned the king about the coming war.
ex.zh: 先知向國王警告即將來臨的戰爭。

ex.en: In the legend, a blind seer could see the future.
ex.zh: 傳說中，一位盲眼的預言者能看見未來。

ex.en: The doctor gave him a sedative to help him sleep.
ex.zh: 醫生給他一顆鎮靜劑幫助入睡。

ex.en: The vet used a mild sedative before the surgery.
ex.zh: 獸醫在手術前使用了溫和的鎮靜劑。

ex.en: The tea has a mild sedative effect.
ex.zh: 這種茶有溫和的鎮靜效果。

ex.en: Some cold medicines have a sedative property that makes you sleepy.
ex.zh: 有些感冒藥具有鎮靜作用，會讓人想睡。

ex.en: The old bicycle is still serviceable.
ex.zh: 這輛舊腳踏車還堪用。

ex.en: She bought a plain but serviceable coat for winter.
ex.zh: 她買了一件樸素但耐穿的冬季外套。

ex.en: I am sending you a message right now.
ex.zh: 我現在就傳訊息給你。

ex.en: She is sending her son to a school abroad.
ex.zh: 她打算把兒子送到國外的學校念書。

ex.en: The sending of the email failed because of a network error.
ex.zh: 網路錯誤導致郵件發送失敗。

ex.en: Sending takes only a few seconds with this app.
ex.zh: 用這個應用程式，傳送只要幾秒鐘。

ex.en: The teacher handled the situation sensitively and kindly.
ex.zh: 老師體貼又親切地處理了這個狀況。

ex.en: The device responds sensitively to even a light touch.
ex.zh: 這個裝置連輕輕一碰都會靈敏地反應。

ex.en: The workers lived in servitude and were never paid.
ex.zh: 這些工人過著被奴役的生活，從來沒有領過薪水。

ex.en: The novel tells how people escaped from servitude long ago.
ex.zh: 這本小說講述很久以前人們如何逃離奴役。

ex.en: The town has a sedate pace of life.
ex.zh: 這個小鎮的生活步調從容。

ex.en: They took a sedate walk along the river.
ex.zh: 他們沿著河邊悠閒地散步。

ex.en: The vet had to sedate the dog before the operation.
ex.zh: 獸醫必須在手術前給狗施打鎮靜劑。

ex.en: Doctors decided to sedate the patient to help him rest.
ex.zh: 醫生決定讓病人服鎮靜劑，幫助他休息。

ex.en: The students sat in a semicircle around the teacher.
ex.zh: 學生們圍著老師坐成半圓形。

ex.en: Draw a semicircle on the paper with a compass.
ex.zh: 用圓規在紙上畫一個半圓。

ex.en: The program aims to sensitize students to the needs of others.
ex.zh: 這個計畫旨在讓學生更能體察他人的需求。

ex.en: Repeated exposure can sensitize the skin to certain chemicals.
ex.zh: 反覆接觸可能使皮膚對某些化學物質變得敏感。

ex.en: A lone sentinel stood at the gate all night.
ex.zh: 一名哨兵整晚獨自站在大門口。

ex.en: The tall pine stands like a sentinel over the valley.
ex.zh: 那棵高大的松樹像哨兵一樣守望著山谷。

ex.en: As a secularist, he believes government should stay separate from religion.
ex.zh: 身為主張政教分離的人，他認為政府應與宗教分開。

ex.en: The secularist group asked the school to end the prayer session.
ex.zh: 那個主張政教分離的團體要求學校取消祈禱時間。

ex.en: The little girl collected a seashell on the beach.
ex.zh: 小女孩在海灘上撿了一個貝殼。

ex.en: If you hold a seashell to your ear, you can hear a sound like the sea.
ex.zh: 把貝殼貼近耳朵，你能聽見像海浪的聲音。

ex.en: The Seine flows through the center of Paris.
ex.zh: 塞納河流經巴黎市中心。

ex.en: Tourists take boat rides along the Seine.
ex.zh: 遊客沿著塞納河搭船遊覽。

ex.en: The fishermen pulled the seine onto the beach.
ex.zh: 漁夫把圍網拉上了海灘。

ex.en: A seine is a long net that hangs straight in the water.
ex.zh: 圍網是一種垂直懸掛在水中的長網。

ex.en: Prices for fruit change seasonally.
ex.zh: 水果的價格會隨季節變動。

ex.en: The restaurant seasonally updates its menu.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳會隨季節更新菜單。

ex.en: The radio's selectivity lets it pick up one station without noise.
ex.zh: 這台收音機的選擇性使它能不受雜訊干擾地收單一電台。

ex.en: The university is known for its high selectivity in admissions.
ex.zh: 這所大學以招生篩選嚴格著稱。

ex.en: We collected shells along the seashore.
ex.zh: 我們沿著海邊撿貝殼。

ex.en: Their house stands right on the seashore.
ex.zh: 他們的房子就蓋在海濱邊。

ex.en: Brazil nuts are a rich natural source of selenium.
ex.zh: 巴西堅果是天然硒的豐富來源。

ex.en: Our bodies need a small amount of selenium to stay healthy.
ex.zh: 我們的身體需要少量的硒來維持健康。

ex.en: Separatism has been a sensitive issue in the region for decades.
ex.zh: 幾十年來，分離主義一直是這個地區的敏感議題。

ex.en: The book explores the history of separatism in Europe.
ex.zh: 這本書探討歐洲分離主義的歷史。

ex.en: The files are processed sequentially, one after another.
ex.zh: 這些檔案會一個接一個依序處理。

ex.en: Please number the pages sequentially from one to ten.
ex.zh: 請把頁碼從一到十依序編號。

seeking.zh: 尋找；尋求（seek 的現在分詞）

ex.en: She is seeking advice from her teacher about college.
ex.zh: 她正向老師尋求關於大學的建議。

ex.en: Many people are seeking a quieter life outside the city.
ex.zh: 許多人在尋求城市以外較安靜的生活。

ex.en: The company is seeking new employees for its summer program.
ex.zh: 公司正在為暑期計畫徵求新員工。

ex.en: We drove along a serpentine road up the mountain.
ex.zh: 我們沿著蜿蜒的道路開車上山。

ex.en: The river follows a serpentine path through the valley.
ex.zh: 河流蜿蜒穿過山谷。

ex.en: The trail serpentines up the hill.
ex.zh: 這條小徑蜿蜒著通向山丘上方。

ex.en: The river serpentined through the quiet town.
ex.zh: 河水蜿蜒穿過寧靜的小鎮。

ex.en: Use a serrated knife to cut the soft bread.
ex.zh: 用鋸齒刀來切柔軟的麵包。

ex.en: The leaves of this plant have serrated edges.
ex.zh: 這種植物的葉子邊緣呈鋸齒狀。

ex.en: He was too servile around his boss.
ex.zh: 他在老闆面前太過卑躬屈膝。

ex.en: I dislike servile people who agree with everything.
ex.zh: 我不喜歡那種對什麼都附和的諂媚者。

ex.en: Many large cities lie along the eastern seaboard.
ex.zh: 許多大城市坐落在東部沿海地區。

ex.en: The storm moved slowly up the seaboard.
ex.zh: 暴風雨沿著海岸慢慢北移。

ex.en: They live in a quiet seaboard town.
ex.zh: 他們住在一個安靜的沿海小鎮。

ex.en: The seaboard states depend on fishing and tourism.
ex.zh: 沿海各州依賴漁業與觀光業。

ex.en: They set up a small bakery in their hometown.
ex.zh: 他們在家鄉開了一間小麵包店。

ex.en: The school set up a club for young scientists.
ex.zh: 學校成立了一個少年科學家社團。

set up.en: to start something such as a company or an organization

ex.en: It took an hour to set up the new router.
ex.zh: 安裝新的路由器花了一個小時。

ex.en: Can you help me set up my email account?
ex.zh: 你可以幫我設定電子郵件帳號嗎？

set up.en: to put equipment in place and make it ready to use

ex.en: Let's set up a meeting for next Tuesday afternoon.
ex.zh: 我們來安排下週二下午開個會吧。

ex.en: She set up an interview with the manager.
ex.zh: 她安排了一場和經理的面談。

set up.en: to arrange something such as a meeting or an event

ex.en: He claimed that his coworkers had set him up.
ex.zh: 他聲稱同事陷害了他。

ex.en: The police later found out the man had been set up.
ex.zh: 警方後來發現那名男子是被設計陷害的。

set up.en: to trick someone so that they get blamed for something they did not do

ex.en: We went to the airport to see him off.
ex.zh: 我們到機場為他送行。

ex.en: My parents saw me off at the station.
ex.zh: 我父母到車站送我。

see off.en: to go with someone to say goodbye when they leave

ex.en: The concert tickets sold out in an hour.
ex.zh: 演唱會門票一小時就賣完了。

ex.en: This cake always sells out by noon.
ex.zh: 這種蛋糕總是在中午前就賣完。

sell out.en: when all the items or tickets are sold

ex.en: Fans said the singer sold out for money.
ex.zh: 粉絲說這位歌手為了錢而背棄初衷。

ex.en: He never sold out his friends.
ex.zh: 他從來沒有出賣過他的朋友。

sell out.en: to give up your beliefs for money or personal gain

ex.en: I sent the shoes back because they were too small.
ex.zh: 鞋子太小，所以我把它們退了回去。

ex.en: Please send back the form by Friday.
ex.zh: 請在星期五前把表格寄回。

send back.en: to return something to the person who sent it

ex.en: I sent off the letter this morning.
ex.zh: 我今天早上把信寄出去了。

ex.en: She sent off her application yesterday.
ex.zh: 她昨天把申請書寄出去了。

send off.en: to post or deliver something to another place

ex.en: The whole class sent off our teacher with flowers.
ex.zh: 全班用花束歡送我們的老師。

ex.en: They sent the team off with a big cheer.
ex.zh: 他們以熱烈的歡呼為球隊送行。

send off.en: to say goodbye to someone who is leaving

ex.en: We sent out the invitations last week.
ex.zh: 我們上週發出了邀請函。

ex.en: The school sends out a newsletter every month.
ex.zh: 學校每個月都會寄發一份通訊。

send out.en: to send many things or a signal to different people or places

ex.en: The company sent out a team to fix the problem.
ex.zh: 公司派了一個小組去解決問題。

ex.en: They sent out volunteers to hand out food.
ex.zh: 他們派出志工去發放食物。

send out.en: to tell someone to go somewhere for a job

ex.en: I set aside an hour every day to read.
ex.zh: 我每天撥出一小時閱讀。

ex.en: They set aside money for their trip.
ex.zh: 他們把錢存下來準備旅行用。

set aside.en: to keep time or money for a special purpose

ex.en: Let's set aside our worries and enjoy the day.
ex.zh: 讓我們把煩惱擱在一邊，好好享受今天。

ex.en: She set aside her work to help her friend.
ex.zh: 她把工作先放一邊去幫朋友。

set aside.en: to stop thinking about something for now

ex.en: We set off for the mountains at six.
ex.zh: 我們六點動身前往山區。

ex.en: They set off early to avoid traffic.
ex.zh: 他們很早出發以避開車潮。

ex.en: Burnt toast set off the smoke alarm.
ex.zh: 烤焦的吐司觸發了煙霧警報器。

ex.en: The dog's barking set off the car alarm.
ex.zh: 狗的叫聲觸發了汽車警報。

set off.en: to make an alarm or device start working

ex.en: His joke set off a wave of laughter.
ex.zh: 他的笑話引起一陣笑聲。

ex.en: The news set off a debate online.
ex.zh: 這則新聞在網路上引發了討論。

set off.en: to cause something to start happening

ex.en: The dark frame sets off the bright painting.
ex.zh: 深色的畫框襯托出明亮的畫作。

ex.en: A simple necklace can set off a plain dress.
ex.zh: 一條簡單的項鍊可以襯托樸素的洋裝。

set off.en: to make something look better by contrast

ex.en: They set out at dawn to climb the mountain.
ex.zh: 他們黎明時出發去爬山。

ex.en: We set out for home after the concert.
ex.zh: 演唱會結束後我們動身回家。

ex.en: She set out to learn a new language.
ex.zh: 她開始著手學習一種新語言。

ex.en: We set out to build a better website.
ex.zh: 我們著手打造一個更好的網站。

set out.en: to begin doing something with a clear goal

ex.en: The report sets out the main problems clearly.
ex.zh: 這份報告清楚地列出了主要問題。

ex.en: He set out his ideas in a short email.
ex.zh: 他在一封簡短的電子郵件中說明了他的想法。

set out.en: to explain or list something clearly

ex.en: They want to settle down in Hsinchu.
ex.zh: 他們想在新竹安定下來。

ex.en: He traveled for years before he settled down.
ex.zh: 他旅行了好幾年才安定下來。

settle down.en: to start a quiet life in one place

ex.en: Settle down, everyone, class is starting.
ex.zh: 大家安靜下來，要上課了。

ex.en: The baby settled down after a warm bath.
ex.zh: 寶寶洗完熱水澡後就安靜下來了。

ex.en: She settled down on the sofa with a good book.
ex.zh: 她安穩地坐在沙發上看一本好書。

ex.en: The children settled down to watch the movie.
ex.zh: 孩子們坐好準備看電影。

settle down.en: to get comfortable in a seat or place

ex.en: It took us a week to settle in.
ex.zh: 我們花了一週才安頓下來。

ex.en: The new student is slowly settling in.
ex.zh: 那位轉學生正慢慢適應環境。

settle in.en: to get used to a new home or place

ex.en: The young runner set a record at the school sports day.
ex.zh: 那位年輕的跑者在學校運動會上創下紀錄。

ex.en: This film set a record for the most tickets sold in a week.
ex.zh: 這部電影創下了一週內票房最高的紀錄。

set a record.en: to do something better than anyone has done before

ex.en: I set an alarm for six o'clock so I won't be late.
ex.zh: 我設了六點的鬧鐘，才不會遲到。

ex.en: Did you set an alarm on your phone last night?
ex.zh: 你昨晚有在手機上設鬧鐘嗎？

set an alarm.en: to prepare an alarm clock to ring at a certain time

ex.en: The campers set fire to a pile of dry wood.
ex.zh: 露營的人點燃了一堆乾柴。

ex.en: Careless sparks can set fire to dry grass.
ex.zh: 不小心的火花可能會點燃乾草。

ex.en: The new law set in motion many changes in the city.
ex.zh: 這項新法律讓城市開始出現許多改變。

ex.en: He set in motion his plan by calling his friends.
ex.zh: 他打電話給朋友，讓計畫開始進行。

set in motion.en: to start a process or a series of events

ex.en: Can you set the table while I finish cooking?
ex.zh: 我煮完飯之前，你可以先擺好餐具嗎？

ex.en: The children set the table for dinner every night.
ex.zh: 孩子們每天晚上都會擺好晚餐的餐具。

set the table.en: to put plates, forks, and glasses on the table before a meal

ex.en: I have to go now, so see you later.
ex.zh: 我得走了，待會見。

ex.en: See you later! Call me when you get home.
ex.zh: 回頭見！到家時打電話給我。

see you later.en: used to say goodbye when you expect to meet again soon

ex.en: Thanks for your help today, and see you tomorrow.
ex.zh: 謝謝你今天的幫忙，明天見。

ex.en: The teacher waved and said, "See you tomorrow, class!"
ex.zh: 老師揮揮手說：「同學們，明天見！」

see you tomorrow.en: used to say goodbye until the next day

ex.en: My boss and I don't always see eye to eye.
ex.zh: 我和老闆的看法不見得總是一致。

ex.en: The two brothers rarely see eye to eye on money.
ex.zh: 這兩兄弟在金錢上很少意見一致。

ex.en: We finally saw eye to eye on the price.
ex.zh: 我們終於在價錢上達成共識。
